relationships.subject: cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: In the acute model, CBD significantly reduced NTG-induced trigeminal hyperalgesia and CGRP and cytokine mRNA levels in peripheral and central sites.

relationships.subject: cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: In the chronic model, CBD caused a significant decrease in NTG-induced IL-6 protein levels in the medulla-pons, and trigeminal ganglion.

relationships.subject: nitroglycerin
relationships.evidence_quote: NTG administration increased gene expression of CGRP (Fig. 5), Tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha) (Fig. 6), and interleukin-6 (IL)-6 (Fig. 7) in the medulla-pons, CSC and TG, and meninges when compared with the CT group.

relationships.subject: cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: CBD, at both doses, significantly reduced NTG-induced nocifensive behavior in Phase II.

key_findings: CBD reduced NTG-induced trigeminal hyperalgesia, CGRP and cytokine expression in rat acute and chronic migraine models.
